newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs close down on Japan Oct machinery orders jump.
newsitem.headline: JGBs close down on Japan Oct machinery orders jump.

text.p: The key March JGB contract ended weaker on Tuesday after a larger-than-expected 44.2 percent month-on-month jump in Japan's private-sector machinery orders.
"The market had priced in 20-30 percent increase. However, the actual figure caught the market off guard," said a major local brokerage trader.
The March ended the session at 125.51, down from 125.82 at Monday finish.
Earlier, the March was sold to a low of 125.50 on talk that Bank of Japan (BOJ) Governor Yasuo Matsushita had said that interest rates had bottomed out, traders said.
